name: Eymistaken's Potion HUD
description: One choice about how your status effects are shown: leave Minecraft's icons alone, weave a duration readout and an expiry warning into them, replace them with a fully configurable list you can put anywhere, or hide them entirely. Runs on its own, and becomes a draggable module when Eymistaken's HUD is installed.

eympotionhud:notes: All three suggestions are genuinely optional and each is guarded by an isModLoaded check: simplecps turns the displays into draggable HUD modules, cloth-config gives the standalone build a settings screen, and modmenu adds the button that opens it.
The simplecps floor carries its -6 suffix on purpose. Semver ranks 1.1.1-7 BELOW plain 1.1.1, so a >=1.1.1 floor would reject the very releases this was built against.
